name: euler2d_prandtl_meyer
title: Prandtl-Meyer expansion round a 10 deg corner at Mach 2 (2D Euler, geometry_2d)

reference.quantity: Mach number downstream of the corner (wall cells, x = 0.4-0.9 m)
reference.source: Prandtl-Meyer function nu(M2) = nu(2) + 10 deg (Anderson 2003, eq. 4.44), aeroflowsim.gasdynamics.expansion

reference.quantity: Pressure ratio p2/p1 downstream of the corner
reference.source: Isentropic relation p2/p1 = (p0/p)(M1) / (p0/p)(M2) with M2 from the Prandtl-Meyer function (Anderson 2003, sec. 4.14)

study.title: Run
notes: Wall cells next to a centred expansion: the first-cell values lag the exact fan slightly on coarse meshes (the fan is smeared over a few cells at the corner).
